description: This PHP file defines a factory class UserRoleManagerFactory, responsible for providing singleton and fresh instances of AbstractUserRoleManager. It manages access to the user role management service, allowing for retrieval and update of user role managers within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerFactory
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and update instances of AbstractUserRoleManager.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of AbstractUserRoleManager, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getNewUserRoleManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AbstractUserRoleManager, regardless of current singleton state.

methods.name: updateUserRoleManager
methods.description: Updates the singleton instance with a new user role manager obtained from the service.
